The Present State Examination (PSE) is a psychiatric assessment tool utilized in child and adolescent psychiatry. Within the context of the Danish national ADHD database, PSE is classified as a [[full-semistructured-interview]], frequently mentioned alongside the K-SADS assessment [^src1]. 

According to the 2023 annual report monitoring the quality of ADHD assessments in Denmark, the mandatory use of comprehensive tools like PSE is being reevaluated. The report concludes that conducting a full semi-structured interview such as PSE or K-SADS is not strictly necessary in every single case [^src1]. This shift in clinical consensus is highly significant for healthcare administration: it forms the direct evidence base for the steering group's new indicator strategy [^src1]. By acknowledging that these intensive interviews are not universally required, the steering group aims to address systemic weaknesses, resource constraints, and geographic inequalities in standardized diagnostic procedures across Danish psychiatric departments.
